meta_description: A luxurious three-story beach vacation home, Blue View is a can't-miss 4-bedroom rental for your next vacation! Click here to learn more today.
description_expanded:
Blue View | Seaside, FL

2308 E County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

"Blue View" is the luxurious beach vacation home you have been searching for! This home offers three stories of beautiful views of the Gulf and just steps away from Seaside Town Center. "Blue View" is a 4 bedroom, 4.5 bath home that can accommodate 12 guests during your beach vacation.

This newly constructed and designer home was recently featured in Garden & Gun's national magazine in the April and May edition as a 'dreamy beach bungalow' which you will experience during your stay! The first floor offers a guest bedroom featuring two queen sized beds, a bunk nook with a twin over twin bunk, and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combination. The next guest bedroom offers two twin xl beds and a private bathroom with a glass shower. One of the two laundry rooms is located on the first floor, as well as a charming living space for convenience.

The second floor offers two additional bedrooms. The master suite features a king sized bed and private bathroom with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual sink vanity with no detail spared. The final bedroom offers a queen size bed and private bathroom with a glass shower and a dual-sink marble vanity. Beautiful living space is available with comfortable seating and access to the balcony that boast stunning views of Seaside. Additional laundry room is available on the second floor.

The third floor of this elegant beach home provides incredible views of the gulf and white sandy beaches. With vaulted ceilings, natural light pours into the den that openly flows into the gourmet kitchen. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a large marble center island, and beautiful open shelving. The cozy breakfast nook is perfect for those wanting to accompany the chef at work, or curl up with a good book. The lovely dining table showcases unobstructed views of the gulf and accommodates 10 guests. Off of the cozy den you will find the balcony featuring an outdoor swing bed that is heavenly for afternoon naps and plenty more comfortable seating!

Please contact the Dune Vacation Rentals' property manager, Robert Kallmeyer, (850) 213-1876 for all questions and inquiries regarding booking Blue View.

**Construction noises may be present.

- Golf cart rentals are not allowed in Seaside.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Seaside Amenity Fees Include: Seaside Parking Passes (2), Wristbands for Beach Access, and Access to the Community Swimming Pools and Tennis Courts.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancellation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to arrival date

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
